The main takeaway from our work is that
trace-fossil tierings in flysch are not random, but are controlled by sediment character and mode of deposition.
tiering in event layers is a primary feature that is not subject to secondary deformation, whereas tiering in background layers is a secondary feature that is subject to deformation.
